consumer: Both existing text-summary jobs call str(counts[word]) once per distinct output word. Exact ordinary int/string one-positional calls currently package CallArgumentValue storage and allocate a one-element bound object array in CallBinder.
proposal: Reuse InvokeSingleInput for actual BuiltinCallable str with one positional exact BigInteger or PyString operand. Share the existing single-value Str rendering expression via one static operation;both synchronous and async executable call consumers use it. Keep the same PyRendering entry,frame/check/exception translation/result transfer and preflights.
expectedRemoval: Argument packaging/binding allocation and dispatch for this ordinary call form. No new binder,registry,owner,pool,cache,mode or rendering kernel;no changes to str type construction/metadata.
compatibility: No public signature or Python behavior change. Alias of actual builtin can qualify;guest shadowed callable cannot. Keywords,expanded calls,codecs,custom instances,containers and other native kinds remain on the existing general routes;custom protocols must still suspend/cancel correctly. No new async capability or lifetime policy.
acceptance: Freeze one short native warm allocation/work pair before source edits:integer and string forms plus dynamic/expanded/non-native controls. Compare every fuel/refusal/error/span boundary;wide integer formatting,identity,retained aliases,rebinding,codec diagnostics and actual __str__/__repr__/descriptor I/O/cancellation. Reuse IntegerRenderingAdmissionTests,StringProtocolBoundaryTests,IntegerRenderingTests,StringProtocolTests,codec tests,90 owner cases and58 complete jobs. No elapsed/CPython gain prediction;no VM lane.
stop: Only single-positional BigInteger/PyString str call transport. Reject if semantics/fuel/spans/funding change or new lifetime/validation infrastructure is needed. No repr/ascii/format,all-builtin binder,scalar representation,rendering rewrite or metadata audit.
